title: A Study for Teriparatide in Severe Osteoporosis
brief_summary: This observational study will evaluate the incidence of new vertebral and non vertebral fragility fractures in patients with severe osteoporosis treated with anabolic drugs. This study will also evaluate BMD, compliance to treatment, back pain and the health-related quality of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women and men older than 21 years affected by severe osteoporosis with an incidental vertebral or hip fracture during treatment with an antiresorptive, or having 3 or more severe vertebral fractures or having 2 severe vertebral fractures and an historical hip fracture.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any contraindication for the use of antiosteoporotic drug
* Premenopausal women or men younger than 21 years
